mentions.name: SpaceIndex
mentions.description: This site aggregates space industry data from public and free sources into one place, offering an alternative to paywalled data providers.
mentions.problem: Most other space industry data solutions were behind paywalls, even though the data is public or free in one way or another.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Been working on https://spaceindex.io.

I wanted a site that aggregated as much space industry data as possible, but most other solutions were behind paywalls, even though most of this data is public or free in one way or another.
